purpose: Stage and independently review only inert loopback llama-server process/API lifecycle on top of already-bound Local Mistral runtime file descriptors.
baseDependencies: PR #5324 conversion-root authority must be admitted first.
PR #5326 runtime FD binding must be admitted before this stacked segment is eligible to merge.
requiredInvariants: This PR remains inert: it is not wired into a GitHub workflow and does not itself publish review/provider authority or change product/API/database/RBAC/registration/cabinet behavior.

The launcher accepts only the already-bound runtime file object from segment 11; server/model paths must exactly equal internally derived /proc/self/fd/<fd> paths and pass_fds must exactly match those two descriptors.

Before process launch, both descriptors must remain non-inheritable in the parent, regular root-owned files with zero write bits and the admitted device/inode identity; llama-server must retain an execute bit.
Only the explicit server/model descriptors are inherited by llama-server via pass_fds with close_fds=true; no original conversion-root artifact pathname is passed to the process.

Runtime host is fixed to 127.0.0.1. The chosen port is a local ephemeral port and startup fails closed if the launched process exits or the authenticated model endpoint does not expose the exact admitted model alias.
A fresh high-entropy bearer is written to a mode-0600 temporary API-key file and every HTTP request uses that bearer. The launcher does not put the bearer itself in the process argv.
Ambient LLAMA_ARG_* overrides plus LLAMA_API_KEY and LLAMA_PORT are removed from the inherited environment before launch.
HTTP methods/endpoints are restricted to GET/POST and /v1/models or /v1/chat/completions, with fixed request/response byte bounds and JSON-only successful responses.
Runtime shutdown terminates or kills the owned process, removes the API-key file and closes the owned bound descriptors; cleanup failures fail closed.
Prompt construction, semantic review schema, output screening, attestation and provider-status publication remain separately governed.
Local Qwen remains the independent reviewer for this future Local Mistral authority change.
REG.RU remains production authority, mandatory SaaS/API keys remain none and new recurring cost remains 0 RUB.
